name: attraction-youtube-system
description: PLUGIN 6 — the Long-Form Authority Engine for agent attraction (Week 5). YouTube built to attract agents. One-sitting setup: channel → Game Plan → board → workflows → first video. The three categories on the 8-video cycle (3 niche · 1 model breakdown · 4 interviews); one video a week to start, two as the step-up. Ideation from the title formulas and the offer's content branches, scripts in the member's own voice, model breakdowns with no trash talk, thumbnail sheets for Higgsfield, SEO, analytics on which videos brought agent conversations. Two CTAs on every video, from the Week 3 Kit: the guide (comment GUIDE) and the call in Mike's law's shape — the person's help, free, to run the method. Your Notion board gains a YouTube tab: the next 30 days, each card with a real reference video and a publish checklist. Two draft-only workflows switched on with the member’s one Yes — the Monday Kickoff and the Monthly Channel Review — with a short email note each run. Reads the Agent Attraction Brain; requires Plugin 1.
